newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on Cyprus 91-day t-bills 5.59 pct from 5.62.
newsitem.headline: Rate on Cyprus 91-day t-bills 5.59 pct from 5.62.

text.p: The central bank of Cyprus sold 29.0 million pounds worth of 91-day public treasury bills with a coupon of 5.59 percent on Wednesday, compared to 5.62 percent at the last auction held on March 12.
Bids for bills totalling 36.2 million pounds were made for the 22.0 million pounds worth of bills on offer. The bank accepted bids worth 29 million pounds, a central bank statement said.
Treasury bill auctions on behalf of the government of the Republic of Cyprus are held by the central bank twice a month.
